record.dic_text:
0290 'Achiyma`ats {a-khi:-ma'-ats}

源自 0251 和 04619 的同義字; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Ahimaaz 15; 15

亞希瑪斯 = "我兄弟是怒氣 (憤怒)"
1) 掃羅的岳父 (#撒上 14:50|)
2) 撒督的兒子, 曾在押沙龍叛變時協助過大衛王 (#撒下 15:27,36; 17:17|)
3) 負責供應大衛王和王的家人的臣子之一 (#王上 4:15|)
record.edic_text:
0290 'Achiyma`ats {akh-ee-mah'-ats}

from 0251 and the equivalent of 04619;; n pr loc

AV - Ahimaaz 15; 15

Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"
1) father-in-law of Saul
2) Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion
3) a supply officer of Solomon
